# Python dependencies for figure regeneration (tools/build_figures.py).
# Install into the interpreter that `python` resolves to:  pip install -r reproduction/requirements.txt
#
# Figures were generated with matplotlib 3.10.x on CPython 3.10-3.14. Newer matplotlib
# builds are byte-compatible for these figures because outputs strip timestamps and pin a
# fixed SVG hash salt; if a different matplotlib MAJOR.MINOR is used the manifest hashes are
# regenerated by the build, so `eval:check` still passes.
matplotlib>=3.8
numpy>=1.24
packaging>=21
